groups.name: Semantic landmark elements used
groups.definition: Does the page use HTML5 semantic landmark/sectioning elements (header, main, nav, section, article, footer, aside) rather than generic divs?

groups.name: Cards wrapped in article elements
groups.definition: Are repeated posts or cards wrapped in article elements?

groups.name: Clean hierarchical heading outline
groups.definition: Does the page have a clean, properly nested heading hierarchy (e.g. h1, then h2 sections, then h3 items) without skipped levels?

groups.name: Irregular or missing h1 heading
groups.definition: Is the heading outline irregular, such as lacking an h1 or starting at h3 or skipping levels?

groups.name: Item titles use h3 headings
groups.definition: Are card or item titles marked up as h3 headings under h2 sections?

groups.name: Descriptive alt text on images
groups.definition: Do all images carry descriptive, non-empty alt text?

groups.name: Decorative images with empty alt
groups.definition: Do most images use empty alt attributes for decorative purposes?

groups.name: Lean minimal DOM and styling
groups.definition: Is the markup lean, with few divs, classes, scripts, external stylesheets and inline styles?

groups.name: Minimal head meta tags
groups.definition: Does the head contain only a few basic meta tags (charset, viewport, description)?

groups.name: Plain short document title
groups.definition: Is the document title short and plain, without keyword stuffing or decoration?

groups.name: Language attribute declared
groups.definition: Does the html element declare a lang attribute?

groups.name: ARIA attributes and real buttons
groups.definition: Does the page use ARIA attributes and real button elements for interactive controls?

groups.name: Address element for contact details
groups.definition: Are contact details wrapped in an address element?

groups.name: Figure and blockquote for quotes
groups.definition: Are quotes marked up with figure, blockquote and figcaption elements?

groups.name: Strikethrough prices use s tag
groups.definition: Are struck-through prices marked with the s element?

groups.name: Details/summary disclosure widget
groups.definition: Does the page use a native details/summary disclosure?

groups.name: Navigation marked up as lists
groups.definition: Are navigation and link groups marked up as ul/li lists?

groups.name: Class names are semantic rather than utility-style.
groups.definition: Class names are semantic rather than utility-style.
